scope: fresh edition publication, Emerging AI Watchlist refresh, independent live QA, link repair and final verification
resource_policy: Plus Work/Codex allowance and built-in premium image generation only; no paid API, added credits, overage, top-up, upgrade or alternate account

failed_attempts.evidence: The first generation attempt correctly rejected image-review records using sha256 rather than replacement_sha256; the evidence field was corrected before publication.

The first full audit found canonical permanent-page identity regression and omitted media in public analytics availability. Both generator defects were repaired with regression tests before publication.
The local bundle executable was unavailable. Promotion remained blocked until repository CI completed its deterministic Jekyll build successfully.
The optional Spotify platform URL returned HTTP 400 because of one duplicated character. Repair PR #75 corrected canonical and derived views; the final URL returned HTTP 200.
Thirteen of twenty registered watchlist sources returned candidate links; seven timed out, returned HTTP 502, or yielded no candidates. Eight verified topics were retained with original dates.
No supported owner-authenticated Sites connection was exposed for usage recording, private aggregates, priorities, or comments cleanup. No public or indirect fallback was attempted.

usage.reason: The platform did not provide edition-attributed credit or dollar data and the authenticated private usage endpoint was unavailable.
